voices.mls: trained on Multilingual LibriSpeech (openslr.org/94): CC-BY 4.0 (piper-voices MODEL_CARD)
voices.gilles: fine-tuned on a Kaggle French single-speaker dataset (bryanpark): CC0 (piper-voices MODEL_CARD)

kokoro.weights: Kokoro-82M: Apache-2.0 (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M model card); ff_siwis trained on SIWIS, CC BY (VOICES.md, grade B-, under 11 h of data)

xtts.weights: coqui/XTTS-v2: Coqui Public Model License (coqui.ai/cpml), non-commercial (Hugging Face model card)

f5.weights: RASPIAUDIO/F5-French-MixedSpeakers-reduced: CC-BY-NC 4.0, fine-tuned from SWivid/F5-TTS (CC-BY-NC 4.0) on LibriVox French (Hugging Face model cards)
